project_type: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS Progressive Web App (PWA) - Mobile-first financial tracking app
build_system: None - static files, no build step required
build_command: N/A - static site, verify by opening index.html
test_command: N/A - verify HTML validity and JS syntax via browser console
verification_instructions: 1. Open index.html in a browser. 2. Verify all pages load correctly via bottom navigation. 3. Test adding income/expense transactions. 4. Verify localStorage persistence by refreshing. 5. Test budget creation and tracking. 6. Verify charts render correctly. 7. Test export functionality. 8. Test search/filter. 9. Verify dark mode toggle. 10. Verify PWA manifest and service worker registration.
setup_instructions: No setup required - open index.html in browser or serve via any static file server
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full access to CDNs for Font Awesome, Google Fonts, Chart.js
contribution_requirements: Complete replacement of existing Muslim Pedia app with CatatinAja financial tracking app. All UI text in Bahasa Indonesia.
key_patterns: The existing app uses: IIFE module pattern for JS (const Module = (() => { ... return { ... }; })(); ), hash-based routing with page sections in single HTML file, CSS variables for theming with dark mode support, localStorage for all data persistence, Font Awesome icons, Google Fonts (Poppins), mobile-first design with max-width 480px container, service worker for offline PWA support. The new app should follow identical architectural patterns.
relevant_files: index.html - main HTML file with all page sections and bottom nav
css/style.css - all styles with CSS variables, dark mode, mobile-first
js/app.js - main controller with routing, page rendering, event handlers
js/data.js - static data/categories (will become transaction categories)
js/api.js - will be removed/replaced (no external API needed)
sw.js - service worker for offline caching
directory_structure: Flat structure: index.html at root, css/ for stylesheets, js/ for JavaScript modules, assets/ for icons/images. No build tools, no node_modules, no package.json.
